notes: A picture can go on a note for Claude or on an answer to Claude's question: Ctrl+V while typing pastes it, it shows small on the note, and Claude gets it with the note (right-click > Remove Picture to take it off). Claude reads a tag table row as one tag even when the row is drawn a cell at a time. What's at an arrow's tip is the pipe it touches, never a tiny bit of line or a centre line, and a pipe only near the tip is said so. The For Claude button's tip says a drag puts a box round an area.
